newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close below highs.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close below highs.

text.p: Italian shares picked up in late trading to close below the highs on Friday after heaving a sigh of relief at fairly mild U.S. economic data. Declines by bellwether stock ENI continued to weigh heavily on the market.
The all-share mibtel index finished 0.64 percent higher at 11,683 and the mib30 advanced 0.55 percent to 17,219.
Last month's rise in U.S. non-farm payrolls was reported at 175,000, below economists' forecasts, forcing the US jobless rate down to 5.2 percent from 5.3 percent.
Strength in the BTPs market and a buoyant lira also helped shore up the market.
"ENI is performing poorly because of oil price weakness and fears of a stock overhang. It has a big influence on the index," said a Milan-based equities salesman.
The oil company, which accounts for more than one-fifth of the index, closed 1.05 percent lower at 8,015 lire.
Casual clothes maker Benetton closed 2.68 percent higher at 21,217 lire, boosted by positive investor sentiment after the announcement of a better than expected dividend.
Among telecom stocks, Telecom Italia and Stet closed higher while Tim was fractionally lower.
